kyoto_rung_arun_thai.gf_detail: Ask. Thai rice and rice-noodle dishes, but also fried spring rolls, egg noodles, fish-sauce and soy-based sauces; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_rung_arun_thai.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options, but most dishes use fish sauce, shrimp, pork or chicken (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_rung_arun_thai.hours_raw: Tuesday to Sunday and holidays 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–22:00; closed Monday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; bookings lapse 30 minutes after the time without contact; two-hour limit when busy (Tabelog). 23 seats: 5 at the counter, 18 at tables; private hire 20–50; non-smoking; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog). Cards and PayPay (Tabelog). English menu with photos; takeaway (Tabelog). Third floor of 遊里香ビル on Kiyamachi above Sanjo, above a ramen shop; 3 min walk from Sanjo Stn (Keihan) (Tabelog; July 2026). Opened 2 June 2025 (Tabelog).
kyoto_rung_arun_thai.notes: [Thai · Kiyamachi above Sanjo, lunch sets upstairs] A third-floor Thai room on Kiyamachi, opened in 2025, easy to miss above a ramen shop. Lunch sets of about ¥1,100–1,500 bring salad, soup, shrimp chips and a mini dessert with khao man gai, pad thai, green curry or tom yum noodles; staff will steer you to milder dishes. Dinner adds tom yum hot pot and seafood curry with Thai beer. English menu. Busy at lunch — book. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: opened 2 June 2025, serving authentic Thai dishes in a wood-toned room for up to 23. Reviewers in 2026 describe friendly staff, kitchen staff who laughed along with a guest practising Thai, and a busy lunch trade.
chef_bio.specialty: Lunch sets; pad thai; tom yum.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 regular asked the kitchen to teach the Thai phrase for a dish, mispronounced it into an unintended joke, and the whole room laughed — "something Thai people cherish."
"I asked the staff for recommendations on milder dishes, and I ended up having a delicious meal." — May 2026.
"It seems to be a popular spot; I was able to get in early in the evening, but it looked like later customers would have a hard time without a reservation." — May 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: タイ料理・東南アジア料理・エスニック、中京区上大阪町528 遊里香ビル3F、京阪三条駅から徒歩3分、火〜日・祝 11:30〜15:00・17:00〜22:00、月曜休み、予約可 (30分連絡なしで取消、混雑時2時間制)、23席 (カウンター5、テーブル18)、貸切20〜50名、禁煙、Wi-Fi、カード・PayPay 可、英語メニュー、テイクアウト、ベジタリアン対応あり、2025年6月2日オープン、トムヤムクン鍋、ガパオ、シーフードカレー、タイビール。口コミ (2026年5月〜11月、英語): ランチセット (サラダ、スープ、えびせん、ミニデザート)、カオマンガイ1,100円、パッタイ、グリーンカレー、トムヤムラーメン、ポーピアトート、ラートナー1,210円、スップノーマイ1,100円、昼は混む。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu with photos (Tabelog); ask staff for milder dishes; cards and PayPay.

existence.note: Tabelog listing (staff-maintained); reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_ofuro_sanjo.gf_detail: Ask. Izakaya dishes including edamame tempura, a rare salmon cutlet, sushi rolls, hot pots and cheesecake; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_ofuro_sanjo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood-focused izakaya of sashimi, seafood rolls, katsuo tataki, salmon and fish hot pots (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_ofuro_sanjo.hours_raw: Monday and Wednesday to Friday 17:00–23:00; Saturday 15:00–23:00; Sunday 15:00–22:00; closed Tuesday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted by phone; DMs are not answered during opening hours (Tabelog); 19:00 slots fill, with 90-minute seatings at busy times (March 2026). No table charge (Tabelog original チャージ料無し). Orders by smartphone (July 2026). 16 seats: 6 at a ground-floor counter, 10 at tables upstairs; private hire up to 20; non-smoking, smoking area outside (Tabelog; July 2026). Cards (VISA, JCB, AMEX) and PayPay (Tabelog). In the 三条食彩ろぉじ alley of small shops — look for the red noren (Tabelog; April 2026).
kyoto_ofuro_sanjo.notes: [Izakaya · Sanjo food alley, seafood rolls and edamame tempura] A small, young izakaya behind a red noren in a lane of tiny shops off Sanjo: sushi rolls heaped with seafood, edamame tempura, rare salmon cutlet, katsuo tataki and fish hot pots in winter, with fruit sours and sake. Staff are friendly and chatty, and both regulars and travellers fill it — book, as evening slots go fast. One August 2026 guest found the counter noisy. Orders go through your smartphone. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2026 describe a young team cooking dish by dish in a small kitchen, friendly service and drink suggestions, many regulars, and a sister restaurant, SAUNA (April and August 2026).

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 visitor stayed longer than planned, and on the way out one of the staff flashed a peace sign.
"The Edamame Tempura, a popular menu item, was especially tasty and disappeared quickly!" — March 2026.
"I had my meal at the counter, but it was quite noisy, possibly because there were many regular customers." — August 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋、中京区道祐町135-1 三条食彩ろぉじ、月・水〜金 17:00〜23:00、土 15:00〜23:00、日 15:00〜22:00、火曜休み、予約可 (営業中はDMに返信できない)、チャージ料無し、16席 (カウンター6、テーブル10)、貸切20名まで、禁煙 (外に喫煙所)、カード・PayPay 可。口コミ (2026年1月〜8月、英語): 若いスタッフ、姉妹店 SAUNA、海鮮こぼれ巻き、明太子巻き、鰹のたたき、いかのお造り、枝豆の天ぷら、サーモンのレアカツ、クリームチーズのディップ、鱧と松茸の天ぷら、冬は白子、ぶり鍋、日替わりのチーズケーキ、あまおうのサワー、スマホで注文、1階カウンター・2階テーブル、常連が多く騒がしいとの声 (2026年8月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Smartphone ordering; book by phone; no table charge; cards and PayPay.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through August 2026.

kyoto_nakazen_kitashirakawa.gf_detail: Ask. Omakase kappo courses with dashi, soy-based sauces, saba sushi, ganmodoki and fried ginkgo; no gluten information (2022–2026 reviews).
kyoto_nakazen_kitashirakawa.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses of Setouchi fish, hamo, anago, sweetfish and duck liver, on dashi (official site; 2022–2026 reviews).
kyoto_nakazen_kitashirakawa.hours_raw: Monday, Tuesday and Thursday to Sunday 18:30–23:30, last order 20:30; closed Wednesday (official site). Tabelog gives 18:00–24:00 with last seating 22:00, and lunch by reservation only; lunch serves the same courses as dinner (2025 review). Reservations through the official site (AutoReserve) or by phone (official site; Tabelog); book well ahead — locals fill it (June 2025). A fixed course of about ¥14,000–15,000 (2022–2024 reviews); reviewers spent ¥15,000–29,999 (2025–2026). 10 seats: 6 at the counter and one table of 4; non-smoking (Tabelog; February 2024). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners) (official site; Tabelog). Near the corner of the Daikokuya supermarket, Kitashirakawa, by Kyoto University; 3 min walk from the Ginkakuji-michi bus stop (Tabelog; May 2022).
kyoto_nakazen_kitashirakawa.notes: [Kappo · Kitashirakawa, a couple since 2009] A ten-seat kappo near Ginkakuji-michi, opened in 2009 by a husband and wife: the chef (trained at Kikunoi, reviewers say) cooks Setouchi fish and Ohara vegetables into a fixed omakase of around ¥15,000, and the okami, a sake sommelier per one reviewer, pairs local sake or wine. Generous, unfussy and warm, with leftover rice wrapped as onigiri. Popular with locals — book well ahead. Closed Wednesday.

roles: Okami (the wife of the owner, unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: opened in Kitashirakawa in 2009 and run by a married couple; the owner honed skills at famous Kyoto restaurants and wanted a kappo that is easier and freer to enjoy; fish from the Seto Inland Sea and vegetables from Ohara. Reviewers say the owner seems to have trained at Kikunoi (October 2022) and that the chef trained at Kikunoi and the okami is a sake sommelier (February 2026). A September 2025 reviewer calls it a Michelin one-star restaurant.
chef_bio.philosophy: "A kappo to enjoy more closely and more freely" (official site).

anecdotes.text: A February 2024 guest on a fourth visit, coming only every year or two, was still remembered.
February and September, the low seasons in Kyoto, are a "special service month with more extravagant dishes" (February 2024).
A June 2025 guest who could not get a booking on an earlier trip — locals had taken every seat — called the hamo, cut with a large steel knife, the best of a lifetime.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 京都・北白川の夫婦で営む隠れ家的な割烹、2009年開店、京都の名店で腕を磨いた店主、女将の気配り、瀬戸内の魚介と大原の野菜、地酒とイタリア・フランスのワイン、ペアリング、月・火・木〜日 18:30〜23:30 (L.O.20:30)、水曜休み、最寄りは元田中駅、駐車場なし、カード可 (JCB、AMEX、Diners)、予約は公式サイトから。食べログ: 日本料理、左京区北白川久保田町26、銀閣寺道バス停から徒歩3分、10席 (カウンター6、テーブル4)、昼は予約のみ。口コミ (2022年5月〜2026年2月、英語): Kikunoi で修業したという店主、女将は sake sommelier、おまかせ14,000円ほど、2月と9月は特別に豪華、鱧、伝助穴子、ぐじのお椀、八寸、鯖寿司、ご飯の残りはおにぎりに、ミシュラン一つ星との記述 (2025年9月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Book online through the official site (multilingual) well ahead; fixed omakase; cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners).

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through February 2026.

kyoto_synager.gf_detail: Ask. A French tasting course with sauces, terrines, fried amuse-bouches, bread, butter and baked sweets; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_synager.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a set French course of fish, shellfish, foie gras and meat, with butter and cheese (2026 reviews).
kyoto_synager.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–15:00 (last food order 13:00) and dinner 18:00–22:00 (last food order 19:00); closed Monday, open on holidays (Tabelog). Reservation only (Tabelog). 10% service charge (Tabelog original サービス料10%). Courses with wine or non-alcoholic aroma pairings: lunch with four pairings a little over ¥12,000 (September 2026); bills ¥10,000–29,999 (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). 12 seats; private hire for 6 or more, children welcome when booked whole (Tabelog). Cards (incl. UnionPay), e-money and QR (Tabelog). English menu and English-speaking staff (Tabelog). A renovated machiya down a cobbled alley through a small wooden gate, Higashinotoin north of Nijo; 4 min walk from Marutamachi Stn (subway) (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_synager.notes: [French · Higashinotoin Nijo, aromas and non-alcoholic pairings] A twelve-seat French restaurant in a renovated machiya down a cobbled alley near the Imperial Palace, where a chef who is also an herb coordinator builds the course around scent — it opens with rose-distilled water — and pairs it with wine or with non-alcoholic aroma drinks made by herb distillation. Fish, foie gras, game and flower-strewn plates; one diner found the meat sauces rich. Lunch with four pairings is a little over ¥12,000; 10% service. English spoken. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a "unique style: chef × herb coordinator × sommelier"; a chef's course viewed over the kitchen and courtyard, paired with wines by the sommelier or with aroma pairings created by herb distillation. Reviewers in 2026 describe a warm owner greeting guests (February 2026), a team of male staff (September 2026) and a dining room opened up by removing part of the first-floor ceiling of a two-storey house (September 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: "The chef's wish is for you to enjoy your meal time to the fullest" (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner took the full non-alcoholic pairing — kombucha and other drinks standing in for the acidity of white wine, the tannins of red and the sweetness of port — and called it the right decision.
"The sauce for the meat dishes was a bit too rich for my taste, as I'm not fond of spices" — July 2026.
A September 2026 guest found a vegetable mentioned as disliked still appeared in one dish — a small piece, eaten anyway.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: フレンチ・創作料理、中京区東洞院二条上ル壺屋町512-2、地下鉄丸太町駅から徒歩4分、昼 12:00〜15:00 (料理L.O.13:00)、夜 18:00〜22:00 (料理L.O.19:00)、月曜休み (祝日は営業)、完全予約制、サービス料10%、12席、6名以上で貸切可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、英語メニュー・英語のスタッフ、シェフ兼ハーブコーディネーター、ソムリエのワインペアリング、ハーブ蒸留のアロマペアリング (ノンアルコール)。口コミ (2026年2月〜10月、英語): 町家を改装、ダマスクローズの香りの水、Shinshu salmon とキャビア、Yamato tachibana、鱧、まぐろのタルタル、牡蠣のフラン、フォアグラのテリーヌ、ヒグマ、ふぐのジュレ、チーズの盛り合わせ、焼き菓子、昼は4種のペアリングで12,000円あまり。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu and English-speaking staff (Tabelog); reservation only; 10% service.
